pages.text: Three tools: stop it at the source, scrub it out, or shield yourself. Mix them. A tall Flue stack and a few scrubbers keep an average base clear.
pages.title: Three answers
Flue
pages.text: Stack these above a furnace or burner. Each block sends more of its output high and wide, instead of into the chunk below, up to 80% total.

pages.title: Air Scrubber
pages.text: Kinetic: needs rotation and a Filter Cartridge. Cleans its own chunk and the four beside it, faster the faster it spins.

A scrubber wants a $(l:create_basics/rotation)rotation$(/l) input and stress. Funnels and chutes can feed cartridges, and a water pipe wets the filter for a bonus. It also works on a moving contraption, a bit slower.
pages.title: How it works

pages.text: Scrubbers placed side by side share one cartridge and work as a panel, with more output for more stress. A flat 5x5 of 25 reaches upward to break the cloud above.
pages.title: Panels
Filter Cartridge
pages.text: The basic filter. The Brass one holds four times as much, the Precision one sixteen times. Spent ones turn into clogged cartridges.
Clogged cartridges are cleaned by a Fan blowing through water. You get the cartridge back and sometimes Soot. Soot burns as fuel, makes black dye, or compacts to Graphite and a Block of Soot.
pages.title: Washing
Respirator
pages.text: Wear on the head or in an accessory slot. Keeps smog out of you and slowly clears what you breathed in. Wears down as it works.

The Precision Cartridge uses Electron Tubes and Graphite, so the best filter sits behind $(l:create_basics/brass_and_assembly)brass and assembly$(/l). Filter Medium, pressed from soot and string, replaces wool in the basic cartridge.
